description: This file defines the Article controller class for the admin interface of an OpenCart CMS module. It provides CRUD operations, listing, filtering, SEO management, and status toggling for articles, including handling related dependencies like stores, languages, layouts, and SEO URLs.

classes.name: Article
classes.description: Controller class for managing CMS articles in the admin panel, including listing, editing, saving, and deleting articles, as well as toggling status and handling SEO URLs.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point for displaying the article list page, including filters, breadcrumbs, and loading dependencies.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles the AJAX request to fetch the list of articles and outputs the HTML view.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves and compiles the list of articles based on filters, sorting, pagination, and returns the rendered view.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for creating or editing an article, preloading data if editing.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes form submission for creating or updating an article, including validation and SEO URL management.

methods.name: rating
methods.description: Queues a task to recalculate or update the article ratings.
